body:
**Same performance, smaller package**

We've heard your feedback. PHPStan 2.3.0 was chonky! It weighed 104 MB when downloaded and 268 MB after being unzipped in your `vendor/`.

Afer [#6703](https://github.com/phpstan/phpstan-src/pull/6703), PHPStan 2.3.1 weighs just under 28 MB when downloaded and 87 MB unzipped.

Improvements 🔧
=====================

* Ship the turbo extension as a shared core plus a thin extension per PHP version ([#6703](https://github.com/phpstan/phpstan-src/pull/6703)), #15423
* Build Linux ZTS turbo binaries for PHP 8.3-8.5 too ([#6706](https://github.com/phpstan/phpstan-src/pull/6706)), #15422
* Allow PHP 8.6 in `phpstan/turbo` (Composer PIE package) ([#6705](https://github.com/phpstan/phpstan-src/pull/6705))




Bugfixes 🐛
=====================

* Keep the openssl cipher probe's warnings inside the probe ([#6372](https://github.com/phpstan/phpstan-src/pull/6372)), #15176, thanks @SanderMuller!
* Create the implicit throw point of a constructor on the new expression ([#6687](https://github.com/phpstan/phpstan-src/pull/6687)), #15396, thanks @janatjak!
* Read the updated value of consumed prefix mutations ([#6692](https://github.com/phpstan/phpstan-src/pull/6692)), #15411, thanks @drewmt!
* Cache a function reflection under the file that declares it ([#6698](https://github.com/phpstan/phpstan-src/pull/6698)), thanks @SanderMuller!
* Do not export what is declared inside a function or method body ([#6699](https://github.com/phpstan/phpstan-src/pull/6699)), thanks @SanderMuller!




Performance 🏎️
=====================

* Check original type for unresolvable types only when resolved type has one ([#6675](https://github.com/phpstan/phpstan-src/pull/6675)), thanks @Kocal!
* Keep the restored result cache out of forked workers' memory ([#6686](https://github.com/phpstan/phpstan-src/pull/6686)), #15387, thanks @janedbal!
* Save the result cache when a file has a parse error ([#6694](https://github.com/phpstan/phpstan-src/pull/6694)), thanks @SanderMuller!





Internals 🔍
=====================

* Start the cold run of the warm-rewrite test in a new second ([#6697](https://github.com/phpstan/phpstan-src/pull/6697)), thanks @SanderMuller!
